name: sysml-viewer
description: Navigator und Diagramme für SysML-v2-Textmodelle – im Browser und als VS-Code-Erweiterung
author: Wolfgang Becker (ib-wb.de)

scripts.test: python3 tools/build.py && node tests/parser.test.js && node tests/i18n.test.js && node tests/guide.test.js && node tests/extension.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && cd vscode-extension && vsce package --baseContentUrl https://github.com/ib-wb/sysml_viewer/blob/main/vscode-extension --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/ib-wb/sysml_viewer/raw/main/vscode-extension --no-dependencies --out ../dist/
